reference.citation: Welch BL (1947) t-test. Reference impls: scipy.stats.ttest_ind(equal_var=False) and base R stats::t.test. Data: vertical-GRF dynamic range (PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) in healthy controls vs knee-pathology patients, GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020).
reference.description: re-computes the Welch two-sample t-test of control vs patient vertical-GRF dynamic range with scipy.stats.ttest_ind(equal_var=FALSE) and base R t.test and confirms twoSampleTTest reproduces BOTH bit-for-bit; also reports the control/patient mean ratio and the group sizes
